evals.expected_output: Review identifies: (1) \Drupal:: static calls inside a service class — should use injected $this->entityTypeManager; (2) SQL injection vulnerability in searchByKeyword — user input concatenated into SQL string; (3) missing type declarations on properties, parameters, and return types; (4) not using constructor property promotion with readonly; (5) $database parameter has no type hint. Should provide corrected versions.

Review identifies: (1) Doctrine annotation @Block instead of PHP attribute #[Block(...)]; (2) \Drupal:: static call inside a plugin — should use dependency injection via create()/ContainerFactoryPluginInterface; (3) missing #cache metadata on the render array (no tags, contexts, or max-age); (4) missing return type declaration on build(); (5) @Translation annotation instead of new TranslatableMarkup(). Should provide corrected version with PHP attribute, DI, and cache metadata.

Review identifies: (1) hooks should be OOP #[Hook] classes in src/Hook/ not procedural functions in .module — the .module file itself is deprecated in Drupal 11.5 and stops loading in 13, so the file should be deleted after conversion; (2) core_version_requirement: ^11 is too loose for code that should use OOP hooks — recommend ^11.5 || ^12, and does NOT recommend adding hooks_converted to info.yml (not a valid key); (3) \Drupal::currentUser() static call in form_alter — should inject current_user service into the autowired hook class; (4) == comparison instead of === for bundle check; (5) slug generation is naive — should use a transliteration service or Pathauto; (6) missing return types and parameter types. Should provide corrected OOP hook class with constructor injection and no services.yml registration.

Review identifies: (1) both routes missing requirements: key — no access control at all; (2) deleteItem is a state-changing GET route without CSRF protection — needs _csrf_token: 'TRUE'; (3) \Drupal:: static calls in a controller that extends ControllerBase — should use $this->entityTypeManager(); (4) loadMultiple() with no IDs loads ALL nodes — performance disaster; (5) hardcoded URLs instead of using Url::fromRoute(); (6) missing #cache metadata on render array; (7) deleteItem doesn't check if node exists before deleting — potential null dereference; (8) missing return type declarations.

Review identifies as critical for Drupal 12: (1) hook_module_implements_alter() is removed in 12.0 — replace with the order: parameter (Order::Last) on a #[Hook('form_alter')] method; (2) hook_hook_info() is removed in 12.0 and hooks in legacy_tools.views.inc are silently ignored in 12 — move views_data_alter into a #[Hook] class; (3) the kernel test uses @group/@coversDefaultClass annotations that PHPUnit 12 ignores and lacks #[RunTestsInSeparateProcesses] — convert to #[Group], #[CoversClass], add the isolation attribute and void return types. As standards violations: (4) hook_requirements() is deprecated since 11.3 — use #[Hook('runtime_requirements')] with the RequirementSeverity enum instead of REQUIREMENT_OK; (5) drupal_static() is deprecated in 11.5 — use the memory cache bin or a service property, and inject entity_type.manager instead of \Drupal::; (6) the whole .module file is deprecated in 11.5 and should be deleted after conversion. Must NOT suggest adding hooks_converted: true to info.yml. Should provide a corrected src/Hook/LegacyToolsHooks.php and the converted test class, and reference 14-oop-hooks.md, 12-testing.md and 16-drupal-12-changes.md.
